name: test-once
description: Reuse full-suite or scoped test-command results across agents with declared dependency inputs and honest warm-calibrated savings.

interface.shortDescription: Reuse full-suite or scoped test results across agents.
interface.longDescription: Reuse passing configured test commands across Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor. Whole-repository inputs are the default; explicit dependency scopes enable independent test-file or group reuse. Source, command, environment, platform, and toolchain fingerprints protect cache identity, with single-flight locking and local nominal or warm-calibrated savings statistics. Dependency scopes are declared, not inferred automatically.
defaultPrompt: Configure Test Once for full suites or tests with explicit dependency scopes.
Run or reuse the configured test commands safely.
Show avoided runs and warm-calibrated wall-time savings.
